outcome.answer: For automated topic discovery through clustering, several approaches fit: ClusterFusion combines embedding-guided partitioning with LLM topic summarization and assignment [1]; TriTopic uses a graph integrating embeddings, lexical features, and metadata, with consensus clustering and iterative refinement [2]; and TopiCLEAR clusters embeddings after adaptive dimensionality reduction, with a focus on interpretable topics in short texts [5]. For hierarchical topic structure, another method builds multi-scale clusters from embedding density [8]. If you mean communities of arguments rather than document-topic clusters, a graph-based system detects communities among arguments using topic similarity, semantic coherence, keywords, and entities [7].
